title: Constructing a Polynomial-Time Split Solver
statement: Let $C,e,A$ be natural numbers, let $B$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, and choose a state $a$ of $B$. Assume that for every Boolean word $w$ there is a time $t\le A(|w|+1)^{e+1}$ such that, at every earlier time $t'<t$, the run of $B$ from its initial configuration on $w$ is not in state $a$, and at time $t$ it is in the seam configuration with state $a$ and all work-tape words empty. Assume also that for every pair of Boolean words $w,s$ with $|s|\le |w|+1$, there is a positive time $t\le A(|w|+1)^{e+1}$ such that at every intermediate time $t'$ with $0<t'<t$ the run from the seam configuration with state $a$, input $w$, and tape words assigned from $s$ is not in state $a$. If $|s|+C(|s|+1)^e=|w|$, then at time $t$ this run is halted and has output equal to the encoding of the prefix of $w$ of length $|s|$ together with the remaining suffix; otherwise, at time $t$ it is the seam configuration with state $a$ and tape words assigned from the word obtained by appending true to $s$ when $|s|\le |w|$, and from $s$ unchanged otherwise. Under these assumptions, there exist a finite Boolean Turing machine $M$ and a natural-number constant $c$ that compute, on each input $w$, the encoded split specified by the equation $i+C(i+1)^e=|w|$ (and the empty word if no such $i$ exists) within $c(|w|+1)^{e+2}$ steps, while for every input $x$ and every time $t$ using at most $c(|x|+1)^{e+1}$ space.
hypotheses_covered: C, e, and A are natural numbers
A finite Boolean Turing machine body and a chosen state a
For every Boolean input w, a time t bounded by A(|w|+1)^(e+1) reaches the empty-word seam configuration in state a
Before that time, the initial run never has state a
For all Boolean words w,s with |s|≤|w|+1, a positive round time t bounded by A(|w|+1)^(e+1) exists
At intermediate positive times before the round endpoint, the run from the specified seam configuration avoids state a
When the split equation holds, the round endpoint is halted with the encoded prefix and suffix as output
When the split equation does not hold, the round endpoint is the seam configuration with the prescribed updated tape word
